description: Boop sensor test patterns: the ONE table shared by the simulator (render.py, "boop": "<name>") and the firmware's serial g<N> (fake finger): gen_boop_presets.py turns it into lib/ProtoTracer/Examples/Protogen/BoopPresets.h, g = that N. pattern = durations in ms, alternating ON/OFF and starting ON (ON = IsBooped() true). After the last ON segment the sensor goes OFF and stays OFF.

doble.desc: boop + boooop: tap, release, hold 1.2 s (fires at 0.8 s of hold)

sencillo.desc: plain single boop (strangers at a con)

doble_tap.desc: normal double tap: 2nd press let go long before the hold

suelta.desc: almost: 2nd press let go at 0.5 s (hold needs 0.8 s)

abrazo.desc: hug / resting hand: one 2 s contact

seguido.desc: doble, 1 s quiet, doble again (two face changes)
